ambiguities_or_notes: Exact source bytes revalidated; both printed page markers and the source's chapter-number sequence are preserved.
Evaluative ничего is rendered contextually as 'all right' or 'not bad', not literal 'nothing', except in the formula нечего переделывать ('nothing to redo').
порядочно is kept context-sensitive as 'decent' when standing alone and 'fairly' when modifying 'awkward/empty'.
не едино in the note on chapter XIV is rendered 'not coherent', reflecting Tolstoy's criticism of the chapter as a whole without inventing a more specific defect.
The compressed string иконецъвздоръ is read transparently as 'and the ending is nonsense'; no additional content is supplied.
The source's two deletion spans in chapter XXVI and the jump from XXXIX directly to L are preserved rather than corrected.
